Custom T-shirt details

The Gildan Adult Ultra Cotton® Tall T-Shirt (style G200T) is an adult T-shirt by Gildan that you can order with your logo, team name or artwork on it. It comes in 7 colours in sizes LT - 3XT, so you can mix sizes in a single order and keep one look across your whole team.

Choose where the print goes — a full front, a full back, a left-chest logo or a combination. DTF (direct-to-film) prints full-colour logos, photos and gradients with a soft hand-feel; vinyl heat press suits solid-colour text, names and numbers. Every order gets a proof with the print sized in inches on your garment colour before anything is printed, and production typically takes 7–10 business days after you approve it.

Want to see your logo on it first? Open this T-shirt in Design Studio, place your artwork and send the design with your order. Comparing styles? Browse all t-shirts or all custom apparel.

How to measure: wrap the tape under the arms around the fullest part of the chest. Available sizes for this style: LT - 3XT.

  1. Send your logo in high quality. Vector (SVG, PDF, AI saved as PDF) or a transparent PNG at 300 DPI at the printed size.
  2. Show the placement. A photo, screenshot or sketch of where the logo goes and roughly how big (e.g. left chest 3.5 in, full back 11 in).
  3. Approve the proof. We send a proof with the print sized in inches on your garment colour before anything is printed.

Low-resolution files may print blurry. Need help? Choose “I need a designer” or create your design in Design Studio.

  • Wait 24 hours before the first wash.
  • Wash inside out in cold water with mild detergent; no bleach or fabric softener.
  • Tumble dry low or hang dry.
  • Do not iron directly on the print; do not dry-clean.
FAQ

Questions about this garment.

Is there a minimum order for the G200T?
No. You can order a single piece, and orders above 20 pieces get 5% off the garments and decoration.
Which decoration methods can I choose?
DTF (full colour) or Vinyl heat press. DTF is best for full-colour logos and photos; vinyl heat press is best for solid-colour text, names and numbers.
Where can my logo go?
On the front, the back and the left chest — choose one or more locations. The first location is included in the price per piece and each extra location adds its print cost.
How long does production take?
Typically 7–10 business days after you approve your proof. We send the proof with the print sized in inches on your garment colour before anything is printed.
What file should I send?
A vector logo (SVG, PDF or AI saved as PDF) or a transparent PNG at 300 DPI at the printed size. If you do not have one, choose “I need a designer” or create your design in Design Studio.
